settings.title: A family legacy, woven anew
settings.text:
Corvo is a rug atelier in the north of Portugal. It was founded in 2023 within the Sorema group, the family business that Ramiro Relvas began in 1974.

Two families of textile makers meet in it, Ferreira de Sá and Relvas. Corvo is the work of their third generation.
settings.image_alt: Black-and-white archive photograph of a man in a suit and glasses writing at his desk, in front of a bookcase

settings.title: The man, the manager and the painter
settings.text:
Our story is an ode to a man who, fifty years ago, performed an act of courage. With his son Duarte and his friend Henrique Soares, Ramiro Relvas began the project that would grow into the Sorema group. He wanted something of his own.

Ramiro knew how to reinvent himself. His first venture, car upholstery, had to be rethought after the Portuguese Revolution of 25 April 1974, when assembly lines left the country. He did not give up.

It is because of him that Corvo exists. His paintings, some made more than half a century ago, still inspire our designs: the rugs of From Ink To Thread come from his studies and sketches.
settings.image_alt: Watercolour by Ramiro Relvas: a lake with a wooded island, pines and green hills

settings.title: Two lineages, one atelier
settings.text:
Corvo was born from a family heritage that reaches back on both sides of its founders' lineage: the Ferreira de Sá family, with rugs in its hands since 1947, and the Relvas family, who founded Sorema in 1974.

As part of the Sorema group, Corvo puts that experience into one thing only: luxury bespoke rugs, hand-tufted in Portugal.

settings.image_caption: The workshop, in a photograph from the family archive.

settings.title: Rugs enter the family
settings.text: Joaquim Ferreira de Sá, grandfather of Corvo's owners, founds his rug manufacture. Rugs have been in the family ever since.

settings.title: Sorema is founded
settings.text: Ramiro Relvas starts the company that becomes the Sorema group. It makes bath linens and accessories, and never stops making tufted rugs.

settings.title: Corvo is established
settings.text: A sister company of Sorema, with one purpose: luxury bespoke rugs, tufted by hand.

settings.title: A name from the Azores
settings.text:
Corvo takes its name from the smallest island of the Azores. The archipelago is the family's favourite holiday destination and, more than a place of rest, a source of inspiration.

The Corvo brand was born within a family of brands inspired by those islands. They reflect the values of the founder: family, friendship, trust and dedication.
